shortDescription: Report the configuration state of a running MongoDB instance.

options.name: login_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the MongoDB server.

options.name: login_port
options.description: The port MongoDB is listening on.

options.name: tls_ca_file
options.description: Path to the CA certificate file on the target host.

options.name: tls_cert_key_file
options.description: Path to the combined certificate and private key PEM file on the target host.

options.name: tls_enabled
options.description: When true, attempt to connect with TLS using the provided certificate files. If the cert files do not exist on the target host, or if the TLS handshake fails, the module falls back to a plain connection.
